title: Tiny Quests
tagline: Fun way to achieve short term saving goals through gamification
description:
This project aims to help users with achieving their short term saving goals in a fun and engaging manner. Users will be incentivized to reach their saving goals through gamification mechanisms.
The goal is to also attract partners to partially fund such goals. Bonus rewards will be funded through a fee on the service and penalties when goals are not met.
how_its_made: We are planning to implement this on Celo Minipay using react. Front end will be HTML5 with some canvas libraries for the game components. Given enough time, it will also be extended to run on other chains on desktop browsers as well (since Minipay is only available on Android).
